proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I asked where the production estimate came from and Andrea showed me the source, my bill, and the roof measurements. Three other sellers just said trust the software.
reviews.name: Richard S.

reviews.text: I had a proposal from a phone sales company. Plain Watt went through it with me for an hour and wrote down six questions. Two of the answers changed my mind.
reviews.name: Gloria M.

reviews.text: The inverter kept shutting off around 2 pm in July. They found it was overheating in full sun, moved it to the north wall and added a shade cover. No shutdowns this summer.
reviews.name: Frank D.

reviews.text: Our app showed lower numbers than the first year. They compared it to what the system should make, found one string offline and fixed a loose connector. Back to normal.
reviews.name: Susan O.

reviews.text: We have a tile roof and were worried about cracked tiles. The crew lifted each one, flashed the mounts underneath and replaced the four that broke. You cannot tell from the street.
reviews.name: Arturo P.

reviews.text: After the monsoon the panels had a layer of dust. They came at 6 am, rinsed it all and sent before and after numbers from the app. Simple and clear.
reviews.name: Janet L.

reviews.text: We wanted a battery for the well pump and the fridge. They listed our loads, gave a range for one battery and explained why two was more than we needed.
reviews.name: Bill H.

proof.guarantee: Every number in our proposal names its source. If one does not, we redo the proposal.
